prompt:
A high-fidelity visual design mockup of a MOBILE WEB PAGE, portrait phone viewport, full-bleed screen design. Flat screen design only: no phone hardware frame, no browser chrome, no hands, no device photograph. It is a birthday party invitation page designed as a public theatre street poster in wood type.

STRUCTURE: the entire screen is one continuous posted sheet, edge to edge, no margins, no cards, no navigation bar. Densely packed condensed wood-type capitals at architectural scale, letterpress ink on poster paper with visible wood grain and ink texture in the letterforms.

Exactly FIVE words fill the screen top to bottom, each on its own band, each band rotated onto a different steep diagonal so the bands lean against each other:
  1. HBD, enormous, in dense black wood type on a taxi-yellow ground, the letters so large they are cropped hard by the left and right screen edges.
  2. SUMMER, reversed white out of dense black, cropped by the right edge so the final letter is sliced.
  3. PARTY, in dense black on paper white, the widest band, letters butted tight against each other with no space between them.
  4. 8.28, in dense black on taxi yellow.
  5. 17:00, reversed white out of a single red-orange band, the only red-orange in the image, held for the one piece of information that matters most.

At the very bottom edge, a narrow strip of paper white carrying a small line of Korean text 어반피크닉 워터파티룸 · 분당서현 in tight black condensed capitals, quiet against the shouting above it.

PALETTE, strictly: taxi yellow, paper white, dense black wood-type ink, one red-orange band. No other colour.

Loud, urgent, architectural, cropped, diagonal, entirely typographic. No illustration, no images, no people, no faces, no logos, no photographs, no prices, no invented text beyond what is specified.
